title: Surreal Eye Flower Tower
description: A highly detailed surreal painting features a giant pink eyeball at the center of a teal flower atop a crumbling Colosseum-like tower. In the foreground, a cracked pink bowl overflows with colorful faces, lavender, and melting liquids onto a checkered table holding a yellow vintage camera, while demonic bat-like creatures fly around the structure against concentric rainbow circles.
prompt: surreal scene with a massive pink realistic eyeball forming the center of a dark teal flower growing from the top of a ruined multi-tiered Colosseum tower, demonic bat creatures and skeletons flying around it with black smoke, foreground shows a marble table covered in red checkered cloth with a yellow vintage camera and a cracked pink bowl overflowing with colorful stylized faces, lavender sprigs, coins and dripping red and orange liquids, all set against vibrant concentric rainbow circles in the background, highly detailed, vibrant yet dark atmosphere
